create_prefill_delayer: create a PrefillDelayer instance to negotiate whether prefill requests should be allowed in a distributed scheduler
negotiate_should_allow_prefill: negotiate whether a prefill request should be allowed based on local prefillable status and token usage
negotiate_should_allow_prefill_pure: evaluate prefill allowance as a pure function given previous state, local prefillable flag, and token usage
gather_global_prefill_info: gather global prefillable and token watermark states across distributed processes via all-gather
create_prefill_delayer_single_pass_execu: create a PrefillDelayerSinglePassExecutor to wrap a single negotiation pass with actual execution tracking
record_single_pass_result: record a prefill delayer negotiation result into metrics collector with delay duration and outcome details
